from manim import *
import math

def _fit(mobject, max_width, max_height):
    factor = min(1.0, max_width / max(mobject.width, 1e-9), max_height / max(mobject.height, 1e-9))
    return mobject.scale(factor)

class MutaLesson(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = '#111a18'
        lesson_title = Text('Maths in motion', font_size=38, line_spacing=0.85)
        _fit(lesson_title, 12.2, 0.78).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(lesson_title)
        scene_title = Text('Divide into equal parts', font_size=28)
        _fit(scene_title, 12.0, 0.72).next_to(lesson_title, DOWN, buff=0.08)
        full_narration = 'Each whole is divided into four equal parts.'
        caption = Text('Each whole is divided into four equal parts.', font_size=24, line_spacing=0.85)
        _fit(caption, 12.2, 0.92).to_edge(DOWN)
        cells = VGroup()
        for bar_index in range(1):
            for part_index in range(4):
                order = bar_index * 4 + part_index
                cell = Rectangle(width=9.0 / 4, height=0.9)
                cell.move_to(LEFT * 4.5 + RIGHT * (part_index + 0.5) * (9.0 / 4) + DOWN * (bar_index - (1 - 1) / 2) * 1.15)
                cells.add(cell)
        formula = MathTypst('3/4', font_size=46).next_to(cells, UP, buff=0.35)
        content = cells
        scene_intro = AnimationGroup(FadeIn(scene_title), FadeIn(caption), LaggedStart(*[Create(cell) for cell in cells], lag_ratio=0.06))
        _fit(content, 12.0, 4.6).shift(DOWN * 0.25)
        scene_group = VGroup(scene_title, content, caption)
        self.play(scene_intro, run_time=0.75)
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(FadeOut(scene_group), run_time=0.35)
        scene_title = Text('Show three quarters', font_size=28)
        _fit(scene_title, 12.0, 0.72).next_to(lesson_title, DOWN, buff=0.08)
        full_narration = 'Three of four equal parts are shaded.'
        caption = Text('Three of four equal parts are shaded.', font_size=24, line_spacing=0.85)
        _fit(caption, 12.2, 0.92).to_edge(DOWN)
        cells = VGroup()
        for bar_index in range(1):
            for part_index in range(4):
                order = bar_index * 4 + part_index
                cell = Rectangle(width=9.0 / 4, height=0.9)
                cell.move_to(LEFT * 4.5 + RIGHT * (part_index + 0.5) * (9.0 / 4) + DOWN * (bar_index - (1 - 1) / 2) * 1.15)
                cells.add(cell)
        formula = MathTypst('3/4', font_size=46).next_to(cells, UP, buff=0.35)
        content = VGroup(cells, formula)
        selected_cells = list(cells)[:3]
        shade = AnimationGroup(*[cell.animate.set_fill(TEAL, opacity=0.72) for cell in selected_cells]) if selected_cells else Wait(0.05)
        scene_intro = Succession(AnimationGroup(FadeIn(scene_title), FadeIn(caption), LaggedStart(*[Create(cell) for cell in cells], lag_ratio=0.04)), AnimationGroup(shade, Write(formula)))
        _fit(content, 12.0, 4.6).shift(DOWN * 0.25)
        scene_group = VGroup(scene_title, content, caption)
        self.play(scene_intro, run_time=0.75)
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(FadeOut(scene_group), run_time=0.35)
        scene_title = Text('Build six groups', font_size=28)
        _fit(scene_title, 12.0, 0.72).next_to(lesson_title, DOWN, buff=0.08)
        full_narration = 'Arrange six rows with four in each row.'
        caption = Text('Arrange six rows with four in each row.', font_size=24, line_spacing=0.85)
        _fit(caption, 12.2, 0.92).to_edge(DOWN)
        dots = VGroup()
        for row in range(6):
            for column in range(4):
                dots.add(Dot(radius=0.11, color=TEAL).move_to(RIGHT * (column - (4 - 1) / 2) * 0.62 + DOWN * (row - (6 - 1) / 2) * 0.62))
        addition = Text('4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 24', font_size=30).next_to(dots, DOWN, buff=0.35)
        equation = MathTypst('6 times 4 = 24', font_size=42).next_to(dots, UP, buff=0.35)
        content = dots
        scene_intro = AnimationGroup(FadeIn(scene_title), FadeIn(caption), LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(dot, scale=0.4) for dot in dots], lag_ratio=0.035))
        _fit(content, 12.0, 4.6).shift(DOWN * 0.25)
        scene_group = VGroup(scene_title, content, caption)
        self.play(scene_intro, run_time=0.75)
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(FadeOut(scene_group), run_time=0.35)
        scene_title = Text('Connect repeated addition', font_size=28)
        _fit(scene_title, 12.0, 0.72).next_to(lesson_title, DOWN, buff=0.08)
        full_narration = 'Six groups of four make twenty-four.'
        caption = Text('Six groups of four make twenty-four.', font_size=24, line_spacing=0.85)
        _fit(caption, 12.2, 0.92).to_edge(DOWN)
        dots = VGroup()
        for row in range(6):
            for column in range(4):
                dots.add(Dot(radius=0.11, color=TEAL).move_to(RIGHT * (column - (4 - 1) / 2) * 0.62 + DOWN * (row - (6 - 1) / 2) * 0.62))
        addition = Text('4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 24', font_size=30).next_to(dots, DOWN, buff=0.35)
        equation = MathTypst('6 times 4 = 24', font_size=42).next_to(dots, UP, buff=0.35)
        content = VGroup(dots, addition)
        scene_intro = Succession(AnimationGroup(FadeIn(scene_title), FadeIn(caption), LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(dot, scale=0.4) for dot in dots], lag_ratio=0.025)), Write(addition))
        _fit(content, 12.0, 4.6).shift(DOWN * 0.25)
        scene_group = VGroup(scene_title, content, caption)
        self.play(scene_intro, run_time=0.75)
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(FadeOut(scene_group), run_time=0.35)
        scene_title = Text('Cubic function', font_size=28)
        _fit(scene_title, 12.0, 0.72).next_to(lesson_title, DOWN, buff=0.08)
        full_narration = 'The curve y equals x cubed crosses the origin.'
        caption = Text('The curve y equals x cubed crosses the origin.', font_size=24, line_spacing=0.85)
        _fit(caption, 12.2, 0.92).to_edge(DOWN)
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-3.0, 3.0, (3.0 - -3.0) / 4], y_range=[-31.32, 31.32, (31.32 - -31.32) / 4], x_length=9.2, y_length=4.3, tips=False)
        axis_labels = axes.get_axis_labels(MathTypst('x', font_size=26), MathTypst('y', font_size=26))
        number_labels = VGroup()
        for tick, label in [(-3.0, '-3'), (-1.5, '-1.5'), (0.0, '0'), (1.5, '1.5'), (3.0, '3')]:
            number_labels.add(Text(label, font_size=16).next_to(axes.c2p(tick, -31.32), DOWN, buff=0.08))
        for tick, label in [(-31.32, '-31.3'), (-15.66, '-15.7'), (0.0, '0'), (15.660000000000004, '15.7'), (31.32, '31.3')]:
            number_labels.add(Text(label, font_size=16).next_to(axes.c2p(-3.0, tick), LEFT, buff=0.08))
        domain_label = Text('domain: -3 to 3', font_size=18).next_to(axes, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        curve_segments = VGroup()
        curve_0 = VMobject(color=TEAL, stroke_width=4)
        curve_0.set_points_as_corners([axes.c2p(-3.0, -27.0), axes.c2p(-2.975, -26.330609375), axes.c2p(-2.95, -25.672375000000006), axes.c2p(-2.925, -25.025203124999994), axes.c2p(-2.9, -24.389),
